domain_restrictions: n is such that 1/n is defined and real, so n is nonzero (intended positive integer)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For fixed parameters n and j, for every real d in [0, 1/n) and every real x with x = J_{n,j}(d), we have K_{n,j}(d) = F_n(x). Additionally, K_{n,j}(0) = F_n(j/n).
quantifier_order: for all d (real) such that 0 <= d < 1/n
for all x (real) such that x = J_{n,j}(d)

variables.name: n
variables.role: index/parameter appearing in bounds and in function subscripts

variables.name: j
variables.role: index/parameter appearing in function subscripts and in j/n

variables.name: x
variables.role: auxiliary variable constrained by x = J_{n,j}(d)

witness_dependencies: x is dependent on d via the constraint x = J_{n,j}(d)

statement_nl: For every real d with 0 <= d < 1/n and every real x with x = J_{n,j}(d), one has K_{n,j}(d) = F_n(x), and moreover K_{n,j}(0) = F_n(j/n).
